tool_args.rationale: The low-gradient probe anchors the saturating hydraulic baseline. The remaining residuals support an additive correction gated jointly by input and gradient. Fixing the sink coefficient at the midpoint of the recalled source range and using fixed gate slopes limits the fit to five parameters. All observations are at the requested horizon of 0.6; fresh confirmation is still needed.

considered_alternatives.option: Hydraulic base without a separate branch
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Refitting the base alone still leaves structured residuals; the low-gradient probe stays near the source baseline while higher-gradient rows show a positive correction.
Haldane omits the observed gradient dependence. Cobb–Douglas lacks both input saturation and a separately gated correction.

The six rows already cover weak, intermediate, and strong apparent branch activation at the target horizon. The constrained model's leave-one-out RMSE is about 0.004, so fresh confirmation is the more direct next test.
It does not discriminate between the candidate response laws.
